author: daeron
summary: Prove PhoneVMState.READY on Envy KVM: AUTO_INSTALL=force then disk-boot SRC=/thyris with hidden VGA, bidirectional serial chardev under local /tmp, VIRT_WIFI=0, and real adb shell echo thyris_adb_health. Disk-create stays ISOConverter._create_disk. ISOLINUX installer boot remains a non-READY proof. Windows nographic is exhausted, not READY.

thyris.provenance: snapshots/v0.16/manifest.json domains.thyris plus official android-x86_64-9.0-r2.iso. No prompt_bridge. No second qemu-img owner.

edits.author: daeron
edits.summary: Serial chardev holder instead of -serial file:; VIRT_WIFI=0 keeps eth0 on 10.0.2.15; AF_UNIX socket lives under tempfile.gettempdir() because USB VFAT returns EPERM. READY only after host adb shell returns thyris_adb_health.
